description: For a property \(A\) of elements of \(M\), an element satisfying \(A\) exists if and only if a zero-ary witness function on the unique empty tuple can be interpreted to satisfy \(A\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Skolemization.constant_witness.{w} {M : Type w} (A : M → Prop) :
  (∃ y, A y) ↔ ∃ f, ∀ (xs : Fin 0 → M), A (f xs)
